occupancyCaveat: Mutually exclusive end-of-step labels, in acting/moving/recovering/target/no-target priority order. They observe states, do not identify causal time costs, and moving may include combat movement.
beforeAfterCaveat: The 24 matched Probe1/Probe2 runs isolate wall ordering. Another 360 matched before/after runs isolate shrine arrival. The final 360-run legacy/core comparison uses both corrections for both modes. Winning-only time averages have survivor bias; all outcomes and sample sizes are reported. Ranger seed 1 improved to a clear while Mage variant 1 seed 1 changed to a timeout in the wall-only comparison. No universal clear-rate or speed improvement is claimed.
